title: Android notifications not triggering for newsletters
summary: I set up an AP newsletter in NewsBlur and enabled Android notifications for it, but I’m not receiving any Android notifications at all. As a test, I turned on email notifications and those do work. Other Android notifications from regular feeds are working normally, it only seems to be newsletters that aren’t triggering Android push notifications. Is this expected behavior, or is there something I should check? Thanks
body_markdown:
I set up an AP newsletter in NewsBlur and enabled Android notifications for it, but I’m not receiving any Android notifications at all. As a test, I turned on email notifications and those *do* work.


Other Android notifications from regular feeds are working normally, it only seems to be newsletters that aren’t triggering Android push notifications.


Is this expected behavior, or is there something I should check?


Thanks
